attempts.claim: All 26 registered tests in snowball-tests.json run the same import-only command. It never calls the drill judge, score, stats or chain logic, so it cannot detect a wrong verdict. It also never imports harness.drill_judge or harness.score, and it needs the third-party annotated_types, which no code uses.

drill.py does `from harness import drill_judge`, which fails with ModuleNotFoundError when the file is run as a script from referee/. Python then puts referee/harness on sys.path[0], so the `harness` package is not found. The CLI entry point is therefore broken as invoked.

reproducer.cmd: cd referee && echo '{}' > /tmp/d.json && python harness/drill.py judge /tmp/d.json

attempts.claim: requirements.lock pins annotated-types==0.8.0 with a hash that cannot be checked here. The only consumer is a test import that no code needs, so the pin adds an unneeded and possibly unavailable dependency.
